assumptions.source: Documented engineering assumption; installed PDK has no calibrated GC sheet resistance.
assumptions.pdk_findings: F_RS uses 95*magRS ohm/square for resistor poly GR (8/2), not GC. MOS rsh=44.9607 models source/drain diffusion, not gate poly. Neither is substituted for GC.
assumptions.method: R=Rsheet*L/W for straight rectangular field GC >=10 um long and <=3 um wide, after removing active and contact-cut areas. Orthogonal decomposition splits bends/widenings; these are segment estimates, not total gate-path resistances.
assumptions.limitations: No poly R/C added to transient simulation. No calibrated contact/spreading/distributed-poly model; sensitivity range 5..100 ohm/square. Input poly carries gate charging current; rail guard poly is not a logic-series bus.
